# AZ-900 Practice Section 1

[![Open in Quiz Player](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_in-Quiz_Player-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://quizplay.io/quiz.html?source=quizplay-io/quiz-player-quizzes-az-900-question-set-1)

![Preview](assets/images/preview_az900.svg)

Practice questions for the **Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)** certification exam. This set covers cloud computing concepts like IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS, Azure core architecture and services including VMs, storage, and networking, and Azure management and governance tools such as RBAC, Policy, Cost Management, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud.

## Content Overview

- **36 Questions** — Single choice, multiple choice, and ordering
- **Topics**:
  - Describe Cloud Concepts (25–30%)
  - Describe Azure Architecture and Services (35–40%)
  - Describe Azure Management and Governance (30–35%)

## What This Does Not Cover

This question set focuses on **foundational cloud and Azure concepts**. It does not cover hands-on portal navigation, CLI commands, advanced networking, or deep-dive architecture design. It is not a substitute for official Microsoft Learn training paths.

## Disclaimer

> [!IMPORTANT]
> These questions are **AI-generated** for study and practice purposes. They are **not** exam dumps and do not contain actual questions from the Microsoft certification exam. Use them to test your understanding of Azure concepts, not as a substitute for official study materials.

## Usage

This repository is designed to be used with the [Quiz Player](https://quizplay.io). Click the badge above to launch the quiz directly.
